# PopNow Skills

> Open-source Agent Skills (SKILL.md folders) that let Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Claude.ai and other skill-compatible agents generate AI videos, images, music and speech, apply trending video effects, make finished work (product launch films, narrated explainer videos, landing pages from AI mockups, social covers and thumbnails, brand kits with DESIGN.md, AI assets for HyperFrames videos), and find free ready-made style presets (launch videos, slide decks, web pages) through the PopNow API (https://api.popnow.ai). Skills are free; generations are paid in USD from the separate PopNow API balance behind the API key, and every skill quotes the USD price and waits for the user's confirmation before spending. Scripts are Python 3.8+ standard library only; the make-things skills add Node.js 22+ scripts with no npm dependencies and use local Chrome, FFmpeg and HyperFrames (npx, Apache-2.0). MIT license; bundled fonts are SIL OFL 1.1 (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md); GSAP is not bundled.

PopNow (https://popnow.ai) is a browser-based AI studio for videos, images and music: image-to-video, text-to-video, AI images, music and speech, one-tap trending video effects and image styles. Models include Kling, Seedance, Wan, Vidu, MiniMax, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Flux and Suno. API billing: a separate prepaid API balance in USD (starts at $0, separate from website credits, add funds at https://popnow.ai/api/console/billing), no subscription, same model prices as the website (https://popnow.ai/api/pricing); failed runs release their hold and cost nothing. Typical prices: 5-second video about $0.125-$0.34, image about $0.01-$0.05, song about $0.072.

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add popnow-ai/popnow-skills` then `/plugin install popnow@popnow-skills`. Any agent: `npx skills add popnow-ai/popnow-skills` (skills CLI), or clone and run `./setup --host claude|codex|cursor|gemini|copilot|opencode [--project] [--copy] [--dry-run]` (offline; links skills into ~/.claude/skills, ~/.agents/skills, ~/.cursor/skills, ~/.gemini/skills, ~/.copilot/skills or ~/.config/opencode/skills). Plugin manifests: .claude-plugin/, .codex-plugin/, .cursor-plugin/. Agent-readable install steps: INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md. Requires `POPNOW_API_KEY` (sk-popnow-..., from https://popnow.ai/api/console/keys), exported in the agent's environment.

Flow used by every skill: `POST /api/v1/jobs/quote` -> user confirms the USD price (`maxChargeUsd`) -> `POST /api/v1/jobs/createTask` with quoteId, expectedCostUsd (= maxChargeUsd) and Idempotency-Key -> poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/recordInfo` (`costUsd`) -> download `output.assets[].url`. Amounts are exact USD decimal strings; the credit fields are deprecated.

## Skills

- [popnow-video](skills/popnow-video/SKILL.md): text-to-video, image-to-video, extend, upscale
- [popnow-image](skills/popnow-image/SKILL.md): text-to-image, photo editing, background removal, upscaling, layers
- [popnow-audio](skills/popnow-audio/SKILL.md): music, text-to-speech, transcription, video sound effects
- [popnow-effects](skills/popnow-effects/SKILL.md): 143 trending effects and photo styles (catalog in references/effects.json)
- [popnow-launch-film](skills/popnow-launch-film/SKILL.md): 20-40 s product launch film (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) from a URL, README or repo, built in HTML/CSS/GSAP and rendered with HyperFrames; facts read from the product, contact sheet approved before rendering, loudness-checked mix, X and LinkedIn post copy; optional PopNow stills, B-roll, music and voiceover (about $0.072-$0.50)
- [popnow-narrated-explainer](skills/popnow-narrated-explainer/SKILL.md): 45-120 s narrated explainer video in paper-collage, whiteboard or data-story style; voiceover in 12 languages, captions timed to the words, sourced facts, QA for sync, pace and loudness (about $0.021 lite, up to about $0.44)
- [popnow-landing-page-from-mockup](skills/popnow-landing-page-from-mockup/SKILL.md): landing page designed as 2-3 AI mockups first, built in HTML/CSS or the user's framework, screenshot-compared with the mockup and linted for generic AI design habits (about $0.275, lite about $0.035)
- [popnow-social-cover-generator](skills/popnow-social-cover-generator/SKILL.md): exact-size share images for Open Graph, X, LinkedIn, RedNote, YouTube, Instagram and App Store with real HTML text in bundled OFL fonts; checks for fit, contrast, safe areas and file weight (about $0.10-$0.20 per set, free without pictures)
- [popnow-brand-kit-design-md](skills/popnow-brand-kit-design-md/SKILL.md): brand kit from a brief: three directions, contrast-checked palette, open-licence type, W3C design tokens, voice, outlined SVG wordmark, mockups and brand board, delivered as DESIGN.md (about $0.19-$0.22, lite free)
- [popnow-hyperframes-ai-assets](skills/popnow-hyperframes-ai-assets/SKILL.md): photoreal stills, B-roll, music beds, voiceover and sound effects for a HyperFrames project from one JSON plan; one quoted total, files land in assets/ with provenance and the HyperFrames media ledger
- [popnow-skill-finder](skills/popnow-skill-finder/SKILL.md): finds a free style preset in the PopNow skills catalog (https://popnow.ai/api/skills), shows previews, installs the chosen one and follows it; uses the PopNow developer MCP find_skills/install_skill, else `popnow skills search|add`, else GET /api/v1/agent-skills, /api/v1/agent-skills/{slug}, /api/v1/agent-skills/{slug}/download (302 to a signed link fetched without the API key)
- [popnow-api](skills/popnow-api/SKILL.md): auth, models, tasks, USD billing, errors, webhooks, idempotency, media, assets, OpenAI-compatible /v1/videos, developer MCP
- [popnow-media](skills/popnow-media/SKILL.md): self-contained OpenClaw / ClawHub skill: model schemas, exact USD quotes, explicit approval with a stable idempotency key, task status (MIT-0)
- [popnow-nano-banana-2-1](skills/popnow-nano-banana-2-1/SKILL.md): Nano Banana 2.1 — AI Image Generator & Editor
- [popnow-nano-banana-pro](skills/popnow-nano-banana-pro/SKILL.md): Nano Banana Pro — 4K Text-Heavy Image Generation
- [popnow-seedream](skills/popnow-seedream/SKILL.md): Seedream 5.0 — AI Image Generation, Editing & Layers
- [popnow-gpt-image-2-5](skills/popnow-gpt-image-2-5/SKILL.md): GPT Image 2.5 — OpenAI Image Generator & Editor
- [popnow-flux-2](skills/popnow-flux-2/SKILL.md): FLUX.2 & FLUX 3 Klein — Photoreal AI Images
- [popnow-qwen-image](skills/popnow-qwen-image/SKILL.md): Qwen Image 3.0 & 2.1 — AI Image Generator & Editor
- [popnow-ai-image-generator](skills/popnow-ai-image-generator/SKILL.md): AI Image Generator — 80+ Models in One API
- [popnow-ai-image-editor](skills/popnow-ai-image-editor/SKILL.md): AI Image Editor — Edit Photos with Text Prompts
- [popnow-seedance](skills/popnow-seedance/SKILL.md): Seedance 2.5 — AI Video Generator with Audio
- [popnow-kling](skills/popnow-kling/SKILL.md): Kling 4.0 — AI Video Generation & Editing
- [popnow-minimax-h3](skills/popnow-minimax-h3/SKILL.md): MiniMax H3 (Hailuo) — AI Video with Audio up to 2K
- [popnow-ai-video-generator](skills/popnow-ai-video-generator/SKILL.md): AI Video Generator — Seedance, Kling, Hailuo & More in One API
- [popnow-suno](skills/popnow-suno/SKILL.md): Suno v6 — AI Music & Song Generator
- [popnow-text-to-speech](skills/popnow-text-to-speech/SKILL.md): AI Text to Speech — Gemini, MiniMax, Qwen Voices
- [popnow-faceless-video](skills/popnow-faceless-video/SKILL.md): Faceless Video Generator — Script to Voiced Shorts & YouTube Videos
- [popnow-ugc-ad-video](skills/popnow-ugc-ad-video/SKILL.md): UGC Ad Video Maker — AI Spokesperson & Product Ads
- [popnow-ai-product-photoshoot](skills/popnow-ai-product-photoshoot/SKILL.md): AI Product Photoshoot — Ecommerce Product Images for Amazon & Shopify
- [popnow-ai-short-film](skills/popnow-ai-short-film/SKILL.md): AI Short Film & Short Drama Maker — Script to Multi-Shot Video
- [popnow-ai-comic-generator](skills/popnow-ai-comic-generator/SKILL.md): AI Comic Generator — Consistent Characters, Panels & Pages

## Scripts

- [popnow.py](skills/popnow-api/scripts/popnow.py): balance, models, model, quote, create --confirm-usd <maxChargeUsd> (--confirm-credits N is deprecated), status, wait, download, upload, jobs, usage, retry, purge
- [effects.py](skills/popnow-effects/scripts/effects.py): list, show, quote, create
- [find_skills.py](skills/popnow-skill-finder/scripts/find_skills.py): search, info, install --agent ID [--project] [--dir] [--force] [--dry-run]
- Make-things tools (offline self-tests, nothing charged): launch-film scripts/*.mjs --self-test; narrated-explainer scripts/explainer.py selftest and scripts/kit-selftest.mjs; hyperframes-ai-assets scripts/popnow-assets.mjs --dry-run|--quote|--confirm-usd AMOUNT|--self-test; landing-page-from-mockup and social-cover-generator scripts/selftest.mjs; brand-kit-design-md scripts/selftest.py
- [setup](setup): offline installer for six agents

## PopNow links

- Docs: https://popnow.ai/docs
- OpenAPI: https://popnow.ai/docs/openapi.yaml
- llms.txt: https://popnow.ai/llms.txt
- Developer MCP server: https://api.popnow.ai/api/v1/mcp with an API key (setup: https://popnow.ai/api/mcp; repo: https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-api-mcp; free tools find_skills and install_skill for agent skills)
- Agent skills: https://popnow.ai/api/skills
- API pricing: https://popnow.ai/api/pricing
- API billing (add funds): https://popnow.ai/api/console/billing
- Other repos: https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-api-mcp, https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-python, https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-js, https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-api, https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-blender
